disposition_reason: Table 4 prints dry-weight means of Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn and Cd for 11 commercial plant protein products from Finland.

study.design: Compositional survey of minimally processed commercial plant protein products (faba bean, lupin, rapeseed press cake, flaxseed, oil hemp, buckwheat, quinoa), n = 1-4 suppliers per product
study.market: local grocery stores or directly from farmers/producers, Finland
study.method: ICP-OES for minerals and trace elements; ETAAS for cadmium; HNO3 block digestion; accredited lab (EN ISO/IEC 17025)
study.qa: FINAS-accredited methods; duplicate/triplicate analyses; no CRM or recovery figures printed

controls.control: dehulling of buckwheat (whole peeled seed vs bran fraction)
controls.comparator: buckwheat bran (n = 1) vs whole peeled buckwheat (n = 3)
controls.outcome: Cd 0.0152 vs 0.0047 mg/100 g DW (bran about 3 times higher)

controls.control: hulling and grinding of faba bean
controls.comparator: hulled & grinded (n = 1) vs whole faba bean (n = 4)
controls.outcome: Cd 0.0005 vs 0.0016 mg/100 g DW (whole about 3 times higher)

controls.comparator: pearled vs whole organic quinoa (n = 1 each)
controls.outcome: Cd 0.0036 vs 0.0039 mg/100 g DW (no large difference); Mn 0.46 vs 4.3, Zn 2.4 vs 3.8 mg/100 g DW

controls.control: oil hemp hull vs whole seed
controls.outcome: Cd 0.0015 vs 0.0015 mg/100 g DW (no difference)

unresolved: Ca, K, Mg, P and S (Table 4) are nutrients, not recorded as findings.
Faba bean whole n differs between Table 4 (n = 4) and Methods/Tables 1-3 (n = 3).
Purchase dates not reported. Growing origin per product not stated.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: EU maximum levels for cadmium as discussed
regulatory_or_exposure.value: 0.1 mg/kg (e.g. legumes as stated), 0.2 mg/kg for bran, embryos, wheat and rice; no limits for oil crops or pseudocereals

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Finnish Food Safety Authority advice on flaxseed
regulatory_or_exposure.value: no more than 2 spoonfuls per day; bread may contain 10% flaxseed
